hints: Let dp[i][j] count permutations of 1..i with j inversions; appending i+1 can add 0..i new inversions.
That gives a sliding-window recurrence: dp[i][j] = sum of dp[i-1][j-t] for t in 0..min(i-1, j).
Keep prefix sums to evaluate each row in linear time and take everything modulo 1000000007.
